title: Love Me Tender
tmdbTagline: Love him strong... Love him sweet... Love him tender!
logline: At the end of the Civil War, a Confederate team is ordered to rob a Union payroll train but the war ends leaving these men with their Union loot, until the Feds come looking for it.

title: Loving You
tmdbTagline: You'll Love Loving You
logline: Deke Rivers is a delivery man who is discovered by publicist Glenda Markle and country-western musician Tex Warner who want to promote the talented newcomer to fame and fortune, giving him every break he deserves. Romantic complications arise as Susan, another singer in the group, offers him devoted admiration as Glenda leads him on with promises of a golden future.

title: Jailhouse Rock
tmdbTagline: Elvis in Action as Never Before!
logline: After serving time for manslaughter, young Vince Everett becomes a teenage rock star.

title: King Creole
tmdbTagline: A STORY PULSING WITH THE HEARTBEAT OF TODAY'S YOUTH!
logline: Danny Fisher, young delinquent, flunks out of high school. He quits his job as a busboy in a nightclub, and one night he gets the chance to perform. Success is imminent and the local crime boss Maxie Fields wants to hire him to perform at his night club The Blue Shade. Danny refuses, but Fields won't take no for an answer.

title: G.I. Blues
tmdbTagline: Elvis scores... a singing triumph... and a romantic hit!
logline: Stationed in West Germany, soldier Tulsa McLean hopes to open up a nightclub when he gets out of the army. Tulsa may lack the capital for such a venture, but a chance to raise the cash comes his way through a friendly wager. Local dancer Lili (Juliet Prowse) is a notorious ice queen, and Tulsa bets everything he has that a friend of his can earn her affections. But, when that friend is dispatched to Alaska, it's up to Tulsa to melt Lili's heart.

title: Flaming Star
tmdbTagline: CHOOSE!... Between your white father and your Kiowa mother !
logline: Sam Burton's second wife is a Kiowa, and their son is therefore born mixed-race. When a struggle starts between the whites and the native Kiowas, the Burton family is split between loyalties.

title: Wild in the Country
tmdbTagline: It's all about young people and their growing pains!
logline: A troubled young man discovers that he has a knack for writing when a counselor encourages him to pursue a literary career.

title: Blue Hawaii
tmdbTagline: Ecstatic romance... Exotic dances... Exciting music IN THE WORLD'S LUSHEST PARADISE OF SONG!
logline: Chad Gates has just been discharged from the Army, and is happy to be back in Hawaii with his surf-board, his beach buddies and his girlfriend.

title: Follow That Dream
tmdbTagline: GO! GO! GO! It's Free-Wheeling Fun!
logline: When the Kwimper family car runs out of fuel on a new Florida highway and an officious state supervisor tries to run them off, Pop Kwimper digs in his heels and decides to do a little homesteading. He and his son Toby and their 'adopted' children—Holly, Ariadne, and the twins—start their own little community along a strip of the roadside.

title: Girls! Girls! Girls!
tmdbTagline: The Swingin'-est Elvis! + Girls (Girls, Girls) + Songs (lots of them). Who could ask for anything more?
logline: When he finds out his boss is retiring to Arizona, a sailor, Ross Carpenter, has to find a way to buy the Westwind, a boat that he and his father built. He is also caught between two women: insensitive club singer Robin and sweet Laurel.

title: Kid Galahad
tmdbTagline: Presley packs the the screen's biggest wallop...with the gals...with the gloves...with the guitar!
logline: After completing his military service, Walter Gulick takes a job as a sparring partner at a gym, the owner of which sees potential in Walter as a professional fighter—and takes him under his wing.

title: Fun in Acapulco
tmdbTagline: Come With Elvis to Fabulous Acapulco!
logline: Mike Windgren works on a boat in Acapulco, but when the bratty daughter of the boat owner gets him fired, Mike finds new work as a lifeguard and singer at a local hotel. Tensions increase when Mike runs into the rival lifeguard—who is also the champion diver of Mexico.

title: It Happened at the World's Fair
tmdbTagline: Swinging higher than the space needle with the gals and the songs at the famous Worlds Fair!
logline: Mike and Danny fly a cropduster, but because of Danny's gambling debts, a local sheriff takes custody of it. Trying to earn money, they hitch-hike to the World's Fair in Seattle and, while Danny tries to earn money playing poker, Mike takes care of a small girl whose father has disappeared. Being a ladies' man, he also finds the time to court a young nurse.

title: Kissin' Cousins
tmdbTagline: ELViS feudin' ELViS lovin' ELViS swingin'....as he joins his mountain kinfolk for a hey, hey, hayride to good ol' mountain music!
logline: An Army officer returns to the Smoky Mountains and tries to convince his kinfolk to allow the Army to build a missile site on their land. Once he gets there, he discovers he has a look-alike cousin.

title: Viva Las Vegas
tmdbTagline: Elvis is at the wheel but Ann-Margret drives him wild!
logline: Lucky Jackson arrives in town with his car literally in tow ready for the first Las Vegas Grand Prix - once he has the money to buy an engine. He gets the cash easily enough but mislays it when the pretty swimming pool manageress takes his mind off things. It seems he will lose both race and girl, problems made more difficult by rivalry from Elmo Mancini, fellow racer and womaniser.

title: Roustabout
tmdbTagline: Elvis Presley as a Roving, Restless, Reckless, ROUSTABOUT
logline: After a singer loses his job at a coffee shop, he finds employment at a struggling carnival, but his attempted romance with a teenager leads to friction with her father.

title: Girl Happy
tmdbTagline: Elvis jumps with the campus crowd to make the beach 'ball' bounce!!!
logline: A Chicago mobster hires a rock and roll singer and his band to keep an eye on his daughter during Spring Break in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.

title: Tickle Me
tmdbTagline: Elvis as singing, swinging wrangler on a Dude Ranch... for Girls!
logline: A singing rodeo rider hires on at an expensive all-women dude ranch and beauty spa. He falls for a pretty fitness trainer who is constantly threatened by a gang who wants her late grandfather's cache of gold hidden in a ghost town.

title: Harum Scarum
tmdbTagline: 1001 Swingin' nights as ELVIS brings the Big Beat to Bagdad in a riotous, rockin' rollin' adventure spoof!!!
logline: Johnny Tyronne, action movie star and ladies man, is traveling through the Middle East on a goodwill tour to promote his latest movie, "Sands of the Desert". Once he arrives, however, he is kidnapped by a gang of assassins who were so impressed with his on-screen adventures that they want to hire him to carry out an assassination for them.

title: Frankie and Johnny
tmdbTagline: ELVIS Turns The Land Of The Blues Red Hot With 11 Great Songs!
logline: Johnny is a riverboat entertainer with a big gambling problem. After a fortune-teller tells Johnny how he can change his luck, the appearance of a new 'lady luck' soon causes a cat fight with Johnny's girlfriend, Frankie.

title: Paradise, Hawaiian Style
tmdbTagline: His newest! His Biggest!
logline: Blacklisted by the major airlines for endlessly chasing female staff, pilot Rick Richards returns to Hawaii to set up a helicopter charter company with his friend Danny. Having a girl on every island is a good way to get business but it becomes clear that romance and flying don't always mix.

title: Spinout
tmdbTagline: It's ELVIS with his foot on the gas and no brakes on the fun!!!
logline: Band singer/race driver Mike McCoy must choose between marrying a beautiful rich girl and driving her father's car in a prestigious race.

title: Clambake
tmdbTagline: It's ELVIS barreling... biking... bikini-ing and belting out that W I L D Presley beat
logline: The heir to an oil fortune trades places with a water-ski instructor at a Florida hotel to see if girls will like him for himself, rather than his father's money.

title: Easy Come, Easy Go
tmdbTagline: Elvis rocks the boat!
logline: Navy frogman Ted Jackson balances his time between twin careers as a deep-sea diver and nightclub singer. During a dive, Ted spots sunken treasure and returns with the hope to retrieve it.

title: Double Trouble
tmdbTagline: ELVIS takes mad mod Europe by song as he swings into a brand new adventure filled with dames, diamonds, discotheques, and danger!!
logline: When singer Guy Lambert goes on tour in Europe, he is pursued by two beautiful women, bumbling jewel thieves, and a mysterious killer.

title: Speedway
tmdbTagline: Smooth, fast and in high gear!
logline: A race car driver tries to outrun the beautiful tax auditor out to settle his account.

title: Stay Away, Joe
tmdbTagline: Elvis is kissin' cousins again- and also friends, friends of friends, and even some perfect strangers!
logline: Joe Lightcloud persuades his Congressman to give him 20 heifers and a prize bull so he and his father, Charlie, can prove that the Navajos can successfully raise cattle on the reservation. If their experiment is successful, then the government will help all the Navajo people. But Joe's friend, Bronc Hoverty, accidentally barbecues the prize bull, while Joe sells the heifers to buy plumbing and other home improvements for his stepmother.

title: Live a Little, Love a Little
tmdbTagline: Watch Elvis click with all these chicks!
logline: Photographer Greg Nolan moonlights in two full-time jobs to pay the rent, but has trouble finding time to do them both without his bosses finding out.

title: Change of Habit
tmdbTagline: Could he change her life, could she forget her vows and follow her heart...
logline: Dr. John Carpenter takes the job of running a health center in a low-income district. He enlists three women to help out who — unbeknownst to him — are actually nuns in street clothes. The church wants to improve the neighborhood but fears that nuns in full habit would not be well received. Unaware of her unavailability, John falls for Sister Michelle, serenading her with his guitar — which, luckily for him, effectively wears away at her religious resolve.

title: Charro!
tmdbTagline: On his neck he wore the brand of a killer. On his hip he wore vengeance.
logline: Vince Hackett's gang steals a prized victory canon from Mexico and blames the deed on ex-member Jess Wade, who wants to go straight.

title: The Trouble with Girls
tmdbTagline: Elvis crosses the country...into trouble! trouble! trouble!
logline: Chautauqua manager Walter Hale and his loyal business manager struggle to keep their traveling troupe together in small town America.
